$comment: Bundle budget for the CLI board + overlay artefacts (P17).
Measured on 2026-11-12 on the ui-design-system branch; `deltaBytes` is the
explicit allowance: 2% of the measured size, rounded up to 512 bytes.
2% because the Tailwind v4 pipeline emits stable CSS but JS grows with the
primitives (Base UI pulls its own runtime); anything larger is a real
regression and must be reviewed, not silently absorbed.

Re-measured 2026-11-14 for React 19 (ADR-0019). The upgrade is a deliberate one-off cost, not drift: board +59,932 B (+5.7%) and overlay +305,691 B (+18.9%). Both bundles inline React's PRODUCTION build (NODE_ENV is defined to "production" at build time; no process.env.NODE_ENV survives), so this is React 19's larger runtime, not a dev build or a second copy (checked: one react internals marker in the board, @types path strings are not runtimes). The overlay's absolute cost is the one to watch: it ships inside every annotated page, so a follow-up should try to reclaim it before it grows again.

packages/cli/dist/client/kanban.css.why: board CSS inlined into the served HTML (server/kanban-css.gen.ts); +42 B from the badge ink tokens (--t-status-*-ink, 2026-11-14)

packages/cli/dist/client/overlay-browser.why: overlay client bundle (includes the shadow-root chat + annotation UI; React 19, ADR-0019)

packages/cli/src/client/overlay-css.gen..why: OVERLAY_CSS + OVERLAY_UTIL_CSS sources (P7.2 subset is part of this)

overlayUtilitySubset.why: P7.2 measured 4,910 B for the first subset; the constants are the ONLY styling inside the shadow root, so this number budgets the primitives added since (Select, Tabs, Input, Dialog, Popover, Tooltip) — a second design system inside the shadow root would be the regression
